title: PhDs in the Humanities 2027
level: Prospective PhD candidates (with a supervisor as main applicant)
about: NWO's PhDs in the Humanities 2027 call funds PhD positions at participating humanities faculties. Supervisors apply with candidates pre-selected by their faculty dean; candidates need a (research) master's degree before 1 September 2027.
requirements: Main discipline and primary research question in the humanities
Main applicant is the daily supervisor with a tenured or tenure-track position at a participating humanities faculty
Candidate must complete a (research) master's degree before 1 September 2027 and must not hold or be undertaking a funded PhD
Only candidates pre-selected by the dean of a participating humanities faculty can be submitted; proposal in English

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Main discipline and primary research question in the humanities" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis"
"proposal in English" → objective "Improve academic workflows involving writing support ... and research knowledge management"
